title: Jelly Roll Morton, San Francisco fair and Los Angeles
summary: Compton ran around with Jelly Roll; played the St. Francis Club on the Barbary Coast and returned to Chicago in 1915.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well, I heard Jelly. Jelly and I were pretty close. We did a lot of running around together. Around, around, during the fair in Frisco. I come back here then. Jelly was raising a heck around here then. That was 1915 when I come back to Chicago from San Francisco after the fair. And then we went back to California and Jelly went back. Jelly waked at the Cadillac and we waked at the Waldorf.
Where did you play in San Francisco? Was that Barbary Coast going then? Yes, yes.
I played at the St. Francis Club.

My wife waked at it so different. Lou Purcell's place. Leicester Map. There was 43 saloons in two blocks. You never saw them there? On Pacific Street, huh? Yeah. Never saw them. Well, you got to take one of them.
No, but I've seen it in late years. There wasn't much there. But there was still a little bit there. When I went out in 1940 about, they still had part of it. I right out of one doing nothing.
I didn't do nothing. All the way up the seat on both sides.
